title: コンピュータ概論
subtitle: Introduction to Computers
teachers:
HIRASAWA Kazuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Students will learn the fundamentals of information processing technologies theory, computer components, operating systems, and computer networks.
advice:
This is a basic introduction course to computers. We will cover the following topics:
1.	Theory of information processing technologies
2.	Computer components
3.	Operating systems
4.	Computer networks

Students are expected to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to complete exercises independently.
Students are required to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and be aware of this information during class because the course schedule and content may change depending on the progress of the class.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a basic introduction course to computers. We will cover the following topics:
1.	Theory of information processing technologies
2.	Computer components
3.	Operating systems
4.	Computer networks

Students are expected to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to complete exercises independently.
Students are required to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and be aware of this information during class because the course schedule and content may change depending on the progress of the class.
